title: Weekly Puzzle #44 – Trouble Homebrewing
selftext:
This week I'm pushing the boat out a bit with a pair of homebrew characters that are specifically designed to be interesting in puzzles (or on a very puzzle-esque script like Garden of Sin).

As always, please put proposed solutions behind spoiler markup (> and ! at start, then ! and < at end). Huge thanks to the folks on the [Unofficial Discord's puzzle channel](https://discord.com/channels/569683781800296501/854891541969109033) for their help with playtesting!

[An archive of previous weekly puzzles can be found here.](https://notquitetangible.blogspot.com/2024/11/clocktower-puzzle-archive.html)
